title: useConnect
subtitle: useConnect Hook: Integrate Custom Field Components and UI Libraries with FormFusion

props.name: config
props.description: The form configuration object returned when you invoke the 'useForm()' function.

props.name: type
props.description: The FormFusion input type or validation pattern you intend to apply to the field.

props.name: validation
props.description: Custom validity messages, keyed by the same validity-state names used by Input's 'validation' prop (e.g. 'valueMissing', 'patternMismatch'). Pass 'undefined' to fall back to the type's default messages.

props.name: props
props.description: The props you'd otherwise pass straight to the underlying field, most importantly 'name' (now required - useConnect throws without it), plus optional 'id', 'pattern' and 'mask'. These are merged into the object useConnect returns.
